entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Briefing_Atmosphere
entries.dialogueText: Outside the high arched windows of Palas Rezna, rain beat steadily against the glass. Inside the war room, the massive oak doors had been bolted shut by the Golden Guard. Across the polished mahogany table lay a hand-carved topographical relief map of the Zille peninsula, flanked by brass markers and crimson operational lines.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Opening_1
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. Or perhaps... Romus, if I may speak plainly as your uncle for a fleeting moment.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Opening_2
entries.dialogueText: Thirty years ago, your father signed away Zille with a trembling hand to quell a rebellion that threatened our dynasty. It was a national humiliation that has haunted House Toras ever since. But crossing that river with royal divisions is not a parade. If our offensive stumbles, if Smolak's armored cars reach Brenas, the divine prestige of the Crown—and the stability of the entire kingdom—will be shaken to its foundation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Lucita_Narration_Default
entries.dialogueText: War Councilor Lucita Azaro stood rigid beside the border pins, her uniform immaculate and her posture radiating the unyielding martial pride of House Azaro.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita_Opening_Default
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. The Ministry of War has concluded our operational audit. Our forward strike brigades are concentrated along the Brenas frontier. The army is poised, awaiting your command.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita_Forces
entries.dialogueText: Across the demarcation line, Colonel Valdez commands four entrenched Wehzek regular brigades, bolstered by irregular Republican Guard detachments. His forces are concentrated around the fortified redoubts of Zille City and the central transit hub at Wiktrany. If we strike decisively, we can encircle them before reinforcements arrive from mainland Wehlen.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena_Opening
entries.dialogueText: For Dast's sake, soldiers may fight the war, but the royal exchequer and our state energy reserves will have to carry the burden.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena_Audit
entries.dialogueText: [elenaAuditText]

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Opening
entries.dialogueText: And there is the international chessboard to consider, Your Majesty. Smolak is an eccentric tyrant, but he operates beneath the delicate equilibrium of South Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Geopolitics
entries.dialogueText: United Contana and Chancellor Hegel will certainly howl with outrage at the Alliance of Nations in Kyrute, denouncing us as royalist aggressors. Yet Contana will not send soldiers to die for Wiktor Smolak unless our forces cross into mainland Wehlen. Meanwhile, President Alvarez in Lespia despises Smolak to his core; he will not commit Lespian troops directly, but with proper diplomatic framing, Lespia and ATO will quietly shield us from crippling international sanctions.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus_Security
entries.dialogueText: On the domestic front, Your Majesty, the Golden Guard has placed our agents inside Zille on maximum alert. Furthermore, I have deployed an elite guard detachment with standing orders to secure Queen Mother Estela's childhood estate the moment our vanguards enter the city.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus_Underground
entries.dialogueText: [titusResistanceLine]

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Briefing_Attitude_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: The ministers have laid out the reality, Your Majesty. Before we examine the specific doctrines of attack, how does the Crown intend to approach this fateful hour?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Attitude_Martial
entries.dialogueText: Smolak has mocked our patience for too long. Zille is Rizian blood and soil, and we will reclaim it by the sword.
entries.menuText: "Smolak has mocked our patience for too long. Zille is Rizian blood and soil, and we will reclaim it by the sword."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Attitude_Martial_Reply
entries.dialogueText: A fierce, radiant pride lit up Lucita's face. "Spoken like a true king of Rizia, my love. Our soldiers will march with fire in their hearts knowing their sovereign does not flinch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Attitude_Cautious
entries.dialogueText: I do not take this step lightly. Every Rizian life and every gold guilder spent must serve a clear purpose.
entries.menuText: "I do not take this step lightly. Every Rizian life and every gold guilder spent must serve a clear purpose."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Attitude_Cautious_Reply
entries.dialogueText: "A wise and kingly posture, nephew," Hugo nodded solemnly. "A monarch who counts the cost of the blade rarely loses his crown to recklessness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Attitude_Diplomatic
entries.dialogueText: Our objective is clear: reclaim Zille quickly while keeping the superpowers from intervening.
entries.menuText: "Our objective is clear: reclaim Zille quickly while keeping the superpowers from intervening."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Attitude_Diplomatic_Reply
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Sire," Laurento inclined his head respectfully. "A swift, localized victory presented as a fait accompli will leave even Malenyev and Hegel with no legal basis for escalation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Attitude_Lucita_Personal
entries.dialogueText: I place my complete trust in you, Lucita. Together, we will bring our province home.
entries.menuText: "I place my complete trust in you, Lucita. Together, we will bring our province home."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Attitude_Lucita_Personal_Reply
entries.dialogueText: "I will not fail you, Romus—neither as your general nor as your queen," she answered softly, her fingers gently grazing yours over the edge of the map. Hugo cleared his throat discreetly, adjusting his collar.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Council_Inquiry_Hub
entries.dialogueText: The relief map is at your disposal, Your Majesty. Do you wish to examine any specific operational facet, or are you prepared to select our doctrine of assault?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Inquire_Military
entries.dialogueText: Lucita, detail the terrain and Valdez's defensive layout across the peninsula.
entries.menuText: "Lucita, detail the terrain and Valdez's defensive layout across the peninsula."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Inquire_Military_Answer_1
entries.dialogueText: Zille is framed by the Brenas marshes to the south, the central road junction of Wiktrany, the eastern gate at Nanta, and the northern deepwater port of Munat. Zille City itself sits in the west, shielded by concrete bunkers and coastal artillery.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Inquire_Military_Answer_2
entries.dialogueText: Valdez has dug his infantry into deep trenches along the Wiktrany highway, assuming we will charge head-on. But if we outflank his center or sever his sea supply line through Munat, his garrison will run out of ammunition within days.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Inquire_Economy
entries.dialogueText: Elena, give me a realistic assessment of our supply consumption and financial risks.
entries.menuText: "Elena, give me a realistic assessment of our supply consumption and financial risks."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Inquire_Economy_Answer_1
entries.dialogueText: The logistical cost of moving mechanized columns across Brenas is steep. Requisitioning freight trains, procuring artillery shells, and replacing damaged trucks will drain our treasury every single week of active operations.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Inquire_Economy_Answer_2
entries.dialogueText: If we capture Zille intact, its lucrative gold extraction and customs tariffs will more than repay our expenses over time. But if the fighting drags on, civilian industries in Porte Drazon will face fuel shortages. We must achieve victory quickly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Inquire_Diplomacy
entries.dialogueText: Laurento, how do we guarantee that foreign powers do not turn this into a wider war?
entries.menuText: "Laurento, how do we guarantee that foreign powers do not turn this into a wider war?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Inquire_Diplomacy_Answer_1
entries.dialogueText: We must adhere strictly to sovereign legalism, Sire. Our diplomatic communiqué emphasizes that the 1929 lease has expired and that Rizia is solely restoring constitutional order within its historical border.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Inquire_Diplomacy_Answer_2
entries.dialogueText: Contana will bluster, but their central leadership in Kyrute has no treaty mandate requiring them to declare war over Zille. And Lespia, wanting Smolak weakened, will ensure ATO does not intervene against us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Inquire_Security
entries.dialogueText: Titus, what of internal safety in Brenas and my mother's ancestral estate in Zille?
entries.menuText: "Titus, what of internal safety in Brenas and my mother's ancestral estate in Zille?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Inquire_Security_Answer_1
entries.dialogueText: The Golden Guard has placed our premier royal protection detachment on standby. The instant our spearheads secure the municipal perimeter, they will establish an iron cordon around Queen Mother Estela's estate to ensure no looting or vandalism occurs.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Inquire_Security_Hugo
entries.dialogueText: A vital precaution, Romus. Your mother's lineage is deeply tied to that soil; seeing her family home desecrated by retreating Wehzeks would be a bitter pill for the realm to swallow.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Proceed_To_Doctrines
entries.dialogueText: I have heard enough. Present the operational battle plans for Operation Righteous Sword.
entries.menuText: "I have heard enough. Present the operational battle plans for Operation Righteous Sword."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Doctrine_Presentation_1
entries.dialogueText: At once, Your Majesty. The General Staff has prepared two primary operational doctrines for Phase I.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Doctrine_Presentation_2
entries.dialogueText: Plan Alpha is a concentrated armored breakthrough: smashing directly through the Wiktrany junction from the Brenas staging grounds, shattering Valdez's defensive center, and driving west straight onto Zille City.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Doctrine_Presentation_3
entries.dialogueText: We have prepared two operational pathways, Your Majesty. Either the Crown delegates field execution to the General Staff under one of four doctrines—Hawk, Sword, Ark, or Spear—where our officers execute the campaign, OR Your Majesty takes personal command at the War Table in a frontline operation: either 'Operation Righteous Sword' to reclaim Zille directly, or 'Plan Romulus Ark' to strike across the border into mainland Wehlen. How shall we proceed, Sire?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Plan_Alpha
entries.dialogueText: I authorize Plan Alpha. Concentrate our tanks and smash straight through their central defenses at Wiktrany.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Alpha: Launch a decisive armored spearhead through Wiktrany toward Zille City.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Alpha_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: "It shall be done, my King," Lucita said with steely determination, saluting crisply. "The order of battle is signed. I will meet you at the war table whenever you are ready to command our divisions in Phase I."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Alpha_Hugo
entries.dialogueText: May Saint Wruhec protect our soldiers and grant victory to the Crown. Glovurius axa Rizia!

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Plan_Beta
entries.dialogueText: I authorize Plan Beta. Outflank their fortified line through Nanta and cut off their supplies at Munat.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Beta: Execute an operational envelopment through Nanta and the port of Munat.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Beta_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: "A brilliant tactical maneuver, my love," Lucita smiled with fierce pride. "We will strangle Valdez's garrison before he realizes his retreat is cut off. Our staff is ready at the war table whenever you wish to begin Phase I deployment."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Beta_Laurento
entries.dialogueText: Seizing the deepwater port of Munat early also prevents any foreign vessels from meddling under the guise of relief. Godspeed to our forces, Sire.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Plan_Postpone
entries.dialogueText: Hold the offensive for now. Keep our divisions on alert along the border, but do not cross until I give the command.
entries.menuText: Hold the offensive for now. Keep our divisions on alert along the border, but do not cross.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Postpone_Hugo
entries.dialogueText: A prudent and measured decision, Your Majesty. The General Staff will maintain full readiness along the frontier until you decide the hour is right.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Command
entries.dialogueText: Review the General Staff's operational plans. Our generals and admirals will conduct the campaign.
entries.menuText: Authorize General Staff execution: Delegate field command to our military leadership.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Staff_Doctrines_Overview
entries.dialogueText:
The General Staff stands ready, Sire. Four strategic doctrines have been drawn up:

• Plan Hawk: Relies on aerial bombardment and artillery to shatter enemy junctions before ground units advance.
• Plan Sword: A massive armored fist led by House Azaro divisions pushing through the central axis.
• Plan Ark: A methodical maritime encirclement by the Royal Navy, starving Valdez's supply lines.
• Plan Spear: A covert, high-speed strike by the Golden Guard and mountain commandos to decapitate Wehzek command.

Which staff doctrine do you authorize?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Hawk
entries.dialogueText: Authorize Plan Hawk. Unleash our air wings and heavy batteries. Hammer their fortifications from the sky before a single infantryman crosses the border.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Hawk (Air & Artillery Dominance): Pulverize enemy strongpoints from above.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Staff"; Variable["Zille_War_StaffPlan"] = "Hawk"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Alfa"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Staff_Hawk
entries.dialogueText: "The flight wings are fueled and the spotters in position," Lucita nodded sharply. "Our bombers will turn Valdez's supply dumps into ash. The General Staff will deliver regular situation reports to the throne room as Phase I unfolds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Sword
entries.dialogueText: Authorize Plan Sword. Form an armored spearhead of royal tanks and Azaro motorized divisions to smash through their lines at Wiktrany.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Sword (Armored Breakthrough): Direct our tanks to smash through the center.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Staff"; Variable["Zille_War_StaffPlan"] = "Sword"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Alfa"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Staff_Sword
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro will not disappoint you, my King," Lucita's eyes flashed with ferocious pride. "Our armored columns will ride like thunder. The staff will oversee the battlefield and report our conquests directly to your council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Ark
entries.dialogueText: Authorize Plan Ark. Deploy the Royal Navy to strangle maritime traffic from Wehlen and seal the gulf. Let hunger and isolation do our work.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Ark (Naval Strangulation): Encircle the peninsula and sever Wehlen's sea lanes.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Staff"; Variable["Zille_War_StaffPlan"] = "Ark"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Beta"] = true;

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Staff_Ark
entries.dialogueText: "A calculated, suffocating approach," Laurento observed, adjusting his glasses. "Smolak cannot reinforce by sea without challenging our battleships. Our naval command will report as the noose tightens around Valdez."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Spear
entries.dialogueText: Authorize Plan Spear. Send Titus and the Golden Guard on a covert decapitation strike to seize the command bunker and bridges before Wehlen can react.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Spear (Surgical Strike): Elite commandos and Golden Guard seize key command nodes.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Staff"; Variable["Zille_War_StaffPlan"] = "Spear"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Alfa"] = true;

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Ack_Staff_Spear
entries.dialogueText: "My guardsmen are ready, Sire," Titus said softly, placing a gauntleted fist against his chestplate. "We strike under darkness. Smolak's garrison will find their communications cut and their officers in chains before sunrise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Staff_Back
entries.dialogueText: Let me review our strategic options once more before committing our forces.
entries.menuText: Step back and reconsider the high-level options.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Personal_Command
entries.dialogueText: I will take personal command at the War Table. A King of Rizia does not delegate the liberation of royal soil.
entries.menuText: Take Personal Command at the War Table: Personally direct our divisions in tactical battle.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Personal_Command_Overview
entries.dialogueText:
Spoken like true Toras blood, Your Majesty! The tactical table has two distinct operational theatres mapped:

• Operation Righteous Sword: Concentrates our royal divisions on the Zille peninsula, using our fortified staging grounds in Brenas and coastal waters to liberate Zille, Wiktrany, Munat, and Nanta.
• Plan Romulus Ark: A daring, offensive thrust across the frontier directly into mainland Wehlen, tying down Smolak's reinforcements and threatening his logistics at the source.

Which operational theatre do you wish to command?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Romulus_Sword
entries.dialogueText: Prepare Operation Righteous Sword. We strike directly into the Zille peninsula from our positions in Brenas and liberate our homeland town by town.
entries.menuText: Authorize Operation: Righteous Sword (Zille Peninsula & Brenas): Direct assault to liberate Zille.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Romulus"; Variable["Zille_War_RomulusPlan"] = "Sword"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Alfa"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Romulus_Sword
entries.dialogueText: "The map markers are prepared, my King!" Lucita saluted crisply, her eyes blazing. "Our forward divisions in Brenas await your command. I will meet you at the War Table whenever you are ready to open Phase I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Romulus_Ark
entries.dialogueText: Prepare Plan Romulus Ark. We will cross the river into mainland Wehlen, seize their border corridor, and strangle Zille from behind.
entries.menuText: Authorize Plan Romulus: Ark (Mainland Wehlen & Border Corridor): Strike into Wehlen's heartland.
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_War_PlanType"] = "Romulus"; Variable["Zille_War_RomulusPlan"] = "Ark"; Variable["Zille_War_Active"] = true; Variable["Zille_War_Beta"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Romulus_Ark
entries.dialogueText: "A masterclass in operational audacity!" Lucita grinned fiercely. "Smolak expects us to bleed against his trenches in Zille—he will panic when royal armor crosses into Wehlen proper. The War Table is ready for your deployment, Sire."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Personal_Back
entries.dialogueText: Let me reconsider our operational approach before I take to the table.
entries.menuText: Step back and reconsider the high-level options.

entries.dialogueText: The atmosphere inside the Ministry of War conference chamber was electric with tension. On the table lay logistical manifests of fuel consumption, rail capacity, and requisition orders from the northern provinces.
Your Majesty, we have an intolerable bottleneck along the Brenas corridor. Our heavy transport columns and fuel convoys are being delayed at civilian checkpoints and rail junctions.

The General Staff demands total military requisition authority over the southern rail network, fuel storage depots, and grain silos in Brenas. If my armored spearheads stall outside Wiktrany because local merchants are hoarding boxcars, the responsibility will rest on this council!
Brenas is not an occupied territory, Councilor Azaro! It is the ancestral breadbasket of Rizia and the home of House Sazon!

Your officers are already confiscating livestock, impounding delivery trucks, and leaving our towns on the brink of winter scarcity. If you bleed Brenas dry to feed your armored battalions, you will provoke strikes and unrest across the entire province before your troops ever reach Zille!

Mother is right, Your Majesty. But there is a sensible alternative. House Sazon's agricultural syndicates and merchant guilds have managed these trade roads for generations. If the Crown grants us supervisory authority over the rear, we will guarantee steady deliveries of grain, flour, and fuel without resorting to martial confiscation.

For Dast's sake, both houses need to look at the ledgers rather than their heraldic pride. Councilor Azaro's military requisition method guarantees that artillery batteries receive shells without bureaucratic delay, but officer corruption and haphazard procurement will drain our treasury severely.

The Sazon syndicate model, on the other hand, utilizes local river barges and granaries efficiently reducing our per-turn fuel and budget drain while stiffening the defense of Brenas cities. However, Councilor Azaro's forward offensive tempo may lose its blitzkrieg edge.
All eyes at the table turned toward you. The logistical command of the southern campaign hung on your decision.
Military necessity takes precedence over local trade. Grant Councilor Azaro and the General Staff full requisition authority over the southern transit network. The tanks must keep rolling.
entries.menuText: "Military necessity comes first. Grant House Azaro full requisition powers across Brenas to fuel our offensive."
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Logistics_House"] = "Azaro"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] = Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] - 2; Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseAzaro_Opinion"] = Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseAzaro_Opinion"] + 1; Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseSazon_Opinion"] = Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseSazon_Opinion"] - 1;

entries.dialogueText: "A decisive command, Your Majesty," Lucita nodded with satisfaction. "Our mechanized columns will not lack for a single barrel of fuel or crate of ammunition."
Duchess Angelica tightened her shawl, her face hardening into cold aristocratic disapproval. "The Crown may have its fuel, Sire. Let us hope our farmers do not starve in the process."
We cannot break the back of Brenas to win a battle. House Sazon will oversee rear supply and transit. Utilize your guild networks and granaries to keep our army fed and our people secure.
entries.menuText: "House Sazon will manage the supply lines. Utilize merchant guilds and granaries to protect provincial stability."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty," Manus bowed deeply. "We will ensure that our depots operate with utmost efficiency and fairness. The people of Brenas will stand firmly behind your banners."
Lucita frowned, closing her operational ledger with an audible snap. "I only pray, Sire, that our tanks do not run dry while waiting on Sazon guild manifests."

Neither house will dictate terms unilaterally. Elena Werner and the Ministry of Economy will establish a joint logistical board. Priority corridors will be reserved for military convoys, but all procurement and grain distribution will be handled through Sazon syndicates.
entries.menuText: "Elena Werner will oversee a joint logistics board: military transport gets prioritized routes, but Sazon guilds manage procurement."

entries.dialogueText: "Sensible and balanced, Your Majesty," Elena remarked with an approving nod. "It keeps the army rolling without inviting financial graft or provincial outrage."
"A kingly solution, Romus. Unity between our great houses is the true shield of Rizia."
